promotions.name: Happy Hour
promotions.description: 20% off all drinks every weekday afternoon.
promotions.rule: Apply automatically when the order is placed between 15:00 and 17:00 on a weekday. Discount applies to every drink in the order.

promotions.name: Morning Combo
promotions.description: $1.50 off when you order any hot drink and any pastry before 11 am.
promotions.rule: Apply when the order contains at least one item from 'hot_drinks' and at least one from 'pastries', and the order is placed before 11:00. Discount is a flat $1.50 off the order total.

promotions.name: Weekend Treat
promotions.description: Get a free Chocolate Brownie with any large drink on weekends.
promotions.rule: Apply when the order contains at least one large-size drink on a Saturday or Sunday. Add one Chocolate Brownie (f007) to the order at $0.00.
